cells.gaps: No source found since October 2023 says: is a rule on state data in force.
cells.note: Decree 2026-579 set up a National Digital Committee charged with protecting strategic data (BEN-002), and ASIN proposed sovereign hosting rules for public AI use (BEN-001), so stage 2. An official says Beninese data stays in Benin (BEN-003), but no rule on state data is in force, so not 3.
